rationale: Motor vehicle collision with significant vehicle damage and bodily injury to the policyholder; clearly an auto claim.
claim_summary: Pat Morgan rear-ended at red light on Route 9 (yesterday, 8:15 AM) by vehicle traveling ~35 mph; personal vehicle totaled with severe trunk/frame damage. Claimant sustained whiplash and sprained wrist. Third-party insurance info documented on police report. High severity—requires immediate vehicle assessment and injury follow-up.

case_facts.description: rear-ended by other vehicle traveling approximately 35 mph, vehicle did not brake
case_facts.vehicle_damage: totaled; entire trunk crushed into back seat
